questions.question: 1. Which of the following is a perfect number?

explanations.b: Incorrect. 8 is not a perfect number.
explanations.c: Incorrect. 10 is not a perfect number.
explanations.d: Incorrect. 12 is not a perfect number.

questions.question: 2. What is a proper divisor of a number?

answers.a: A divisor less than the number itself
answers.b: A divisor equal to the number
answers.c: A divisor greater than the number

explanations.a: Correct. Proper divisors are less than the number itself.
explanations.b: Incorrect. The number itself is not a proper divisor.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Divisors greater than the number are not possible.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Not all numbers are divisors.

questions.question: 4. Which of the following numbers is NOT a perfect number?

explanations.c: Correct. 12 is not a perfect number.

questions.question: 5. What is the sum of the proper divisors of 28?

explanations.a: Incorrect. 14 is not the sum of all proper divisors of 28.
explanations.c: Incorrect. 56 is not the sum of proper divisors of 28.
explanations.d: Incorrect. 27 is not the sum of proper divisors of 28.

questions.question: 6. Which of the following best describes a continued fraction?

answers.a: A sum of fractions with increasing denominators
answers.b: A representation of a number as an integer part and a sequence of reciprocals

explanations.a: Incorrect. Continued fractions are not just sums.
explanations.b: Correct. Continued fractions have an integer part and a sequence of reciprocals.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Continued fractions are not products.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Continued fractions are not decimal expansions.

questions.question: 7. Which of the following numbers is the next perfect number after 28?

explanations.a: Incorrect. 120 is not a perfect number.
explanations.b: Correct. 496 is the next perfect number after 28.
explanations.d: Incorrect. 2016 is not a perfect number.

questions.question: 8. Which of the following statements about perfect numbers is true?

explanations.a: Correct. All known perfect numbers are even.
explanations.b: Incorrect. No odd perfect numbers are known.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Perfect numbers are not necessarily prime.

questions.question: 9. What is the continued fraction sequence for 239/51?

explanations.b: Incorrect. This is the sequence for 27/10.
explanations.c: Incorrect. This is not the correct sequence.
explanations.d: Incorrect. This is not the correct sequence.

questions.question: 10. Which of the following is NOT a property of perfect numbers?

answers.a: They are equal to the sum of their proper divisors
answers.b: They are always even (as far as known)

explanations.a: Incorrect. This is the defining property of perfect numbers.
explanations.b: Incorrect. All known perfect numbers are even.
explanations.c: Correct. Perfect numbers are not necessarily prime.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Perfect numbers are indeed rare.
